question: How to implement logistic regression with exact training procedure and fold splitting?
alternatives: Use TensorFlow/PyTorch with custom training loop
rationale: Must follow exact training procedure: 200 iterations, learning rate 0.1, specific weight update rules, logit clipping, and precise fold splitting (k-th consecutive slice). Custom implementation from scratch with NumPy ensures exact compliance with all specifications.
decision: Implement logistic regression from scratch in NumPy with explicit gradient computation and manual update rules to match exact specifications.
expected_effect: Exact reproducibility of the reference implementation. Risk: implementation bugs in gradient computation or fold splitting will cause incorrect results.
falsifier: Results should match reference fit when following 5-fold CV, cross-entropy loss computation, and update rules exactly. If numerical results differ by more than 1e-6, implementation has bug.
